source_request: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create one independently randomized, complex photographic test case for the agent-assigned exact concept verified-safety relief, then use the attached image solely as the primary adult subject's appearance and identity reference so the concept can be judged from visible pixels.
subject: One unmistakably adult night-ferry marine engineer whose appearance and identity follow Image 1, with one adult engineering colleague as the visible safety-confirmation partner.
setting: A working ferry engine room at night, with steel pipes, a bilge-pump inspection port, an analog pressure gauge, an amber alarm beacon, a green status indicator, a torque wrench, an inspection lamp, and a clipboard checklist.
event: Immediately after a non-graphic bilge-pump alarm, the engineer verifies a dry inspection port and a pressure needle in the green band while the colleague points to a steady green status signal; the engineer visibly releases tension, lowers the torque wrench, and resumes the checklist.
visual_priorities: verified-safety relief shown as a visible before-and-after operational sequence rather than an inferred private mental state
the fading amber alarm beacon, dry inspection port, green-band gauge, colleague confirmation, and post-verification tool-lowering action all remain legible in one frame
both shoulders visibly drop, the jaw unclenches, the eyelids soften, and the gloved hand relaxes its grip only after the safe status is confirmed
Image 1 governs only the primary adult engineer's recognizable appearance and identity
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic documentary photograph inside a working night ferry engine room. The primary subject is one unmistakably adult marine engineer whose recognizable facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, and adult age presentation follow Image 1; Image 1 supplies appearance and identity only, while this scene supplies every expression and relationship cue. Show verified-safety relief immediately after a non-graphic bilge-pump alarm: a fading amber alarm beacon remains visible beside a dry inspection port, and the engineer checks an analog pressure gauge whose needle sits clearly in the green band. An adult colleague points to a steady green status indicator and gives a clear confirming nod. Only after that verification, both of the engineer's shoulders visibly drop, the jaw unclenches, the eyelids soften, and the gloved hand relaxes its grip on a torque wrench. The engineer lowers the torque wrench away from the valve housing and resumes marking a clipboard checklist with the other hand. Keep the gauge, colleague confirmation, released face and shoulders, lowered tool, inspection lamp, and damp steel textures legible in a single coherent frame under cool overhead fluorescence with restrained amber spill.
